policy: References support the stated features, not every authored event. No audio, MIDI, chart, proprietary preset or third-party code is imported.

jersey.title: How to make a Jersey club track
jersey.supports: Five-kick foundation at zero-based sixteenth positions 0,4,8,11,14; dotted-eighth spacing, not triplets. Our other lanes are independently arranged.

footwork.title: Creating 808-style basslines for jungle, trap and footwork
footwork.supports: Bass/drum interplay and 808-style sound design in these styles. Our exact triplet and sparse scores are authored examples, not a transcription or universally prescribed grid.

roska.title: Roska lecture
roska.supports: The producer describes skippy, travelling percussion and contrasts rolling/broken approaches; exact event placements here are original.

afro_house.title: Afro house production 101
afro_house.supports: Four-floor foundation with prominent syncopated percussion. Does not prescribe our exact bell/tom score.

ameme.title: AMEME interview
ameme.supports: Producer discussion of polyrhythms and offbeat sequencing; our three-over-four score is an original demonstration.

gqom.title: DJ Lag talks South African music, his global rise and more
gqom.supports: Artist perspective on Gqom and broken rhythms. Supports stylistic context only; our two-bar grids are not artist transcriptions.

brazil.title: Brazilian funk vs. phonk
brazil.supports: Producer perspectives on different Brazilian funk styles and their distinction from phonk; exact low-drum arrangements are our own.

reggae.title: Reggae for Drumset
reggae.supports: Teacher-published method distinguishes one-drop, rockers and steppers and multiple variations. It is not the source of copied charts or media.

one_drop.title: Reggae one-drop lesson
one_drop.supports: Kick and cross-stick on beat three; the supplied bass and tom embellishments are original. Text/search verification only, page fetch unavailable during this pass.

reggae_grids.title: Make reggae music
reggae_grids.supports: Authored tutorial distinguishes beat-3 one-drop, quarter-kick steppers and a beat-1/3 rockers study. Other rockers forms exist.
reggae_grids.verification: Indexed search text was available; direct page fetch returned cache miss.

son_clave.title: Son clave drum pattern
son_clave.supports: Five-stroke two-bar clave with reversible 3-side/2-side ordering. Our drum-kit orchestration is independently authored.

son_grid.title: Son clave
son_grid.supports: Explicit 3-2 placements: 1, & of 2, 4 | 2,3 and reversed 2-3. We preserve the full two-bar cycle.

psy_bass.title: Triplets into rolling bass
psy_bass.supports: Producer tutorial distinguishes triplet and straight rolling grooves. Our KBBB straight-sixteenth score is an illustrative arrangement, not its track transcription.

kilbourne.title: Patch and play: Kilbourne
kilbourne.supports: Producer describes late-beat bass emphasis, reverse-bass swells and modulation within each beat. We import no preset or audio.

italo.title: Italo-disco beat construction
italo.supports: Four-floor/backbeat and machine percussion vocabulary. Our rim/bass placements are not the named track or tutorial MIDI.

tech_house.title: Organic tech-house drum programming
tech_house.supports: Selective shuffle, organic percussion and layered backbeat practice; not a license to reproduce supplied samples.

trance.title: What is trance music?
trance.supports: Quarter-kick trance foundation and offbeat bass context. Our grid is an authored study.

reggaeton.title: What is reggaeton?
reggaeton.supports: Dembow quarter-kick/displaced-snare foundation. Our pickups, bass and dancehall-influenced variant are independent arrangements.

drumeo.title: Drum and bass / jungle beats
drumeo.supports: A drummer demonstrates multiple approaches rather than one universal drum-and-bass pattern.
